BeyondTheBricks / SUPPORT

Support

For help with BeyondTheBricks, contact ycw012@naver.com.

3D viewing and AR placement

Choose a model in Discover Sets to examine it in 3D or place it in your surroundings with AR. You do not need a physical brick set for these features. AR requires camera permission and an AR-capable device.

OS support and experiences

The app requires iPadOS 26 or later. On iPadOS 26, 3D viewing and AR placement are available. Experiences inside supported sets require iPadOS 27 or later.

Is an experience locked?

Recognize a supported physical set and enter its portal for the first time to save access to that experience on this device. You can then open it directly from Discover Sets. Physical recognition is unavailable when recognition data for a set is not yet available.

Camera permission

Check camera access in Settings › Privacy & Security › Camera. Discover Sets and 3D views remain available without camera access. Recognition, AR placement and AR photos require camera access.

Photos and progress

Saving a photo may require permission to add to your Photos library. Settings and unlocked experiences are stored on your device and removed when you delete the app.

Independent fan-made app

BeyondTheBricks is a non-commercial fan project designed and developed by the four members of team ButterCoconut in Challenge 6 of the 2026 program at the Apple Developer Academy @ POSTECH.

BeyondTheBricks is an independent fan-made app. It is not an official LEGO® product. LEGO® is a trademark of the LEGO Group of companies, which does not sponsor, authorize or endorse this app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by NASA.
